title: fix(service-storage): Setup storage Test connection answers in the caller's language (#30335)

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgH3fGSa9E9qgZfcdFLtAhtm)_
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaWLG2RrgKub5oRNjC

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置 → 存储 → 「测试连接」的结果提示按管理员的界面语言显示（成功、下载内容不一致、S3 缺存储桶或区域三种），覆盖平台全部 11 种语言；没给语言或语言不在平台表上时，仍是原来的英文。
- 为什么改：中文控制台点「测试连接」看到的是 `Storage round-trip succeeded (adapter=local).`，管理员可能读不懂下一步。#30551 已让设置动作拿到调用者语言，本 PR 让存储这个按钮用上它。
- 风险与回滚：只动 service-storage 的 `storage/test` 处理器和一个新文案文件；`ok`、`severity`、探针上传下载删除、运维日志都不变；英文调用方的句子一字不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-test-copy.ts`（文案表与 `storageTestCopyLocaleOf` 语言查找）；其次 `storage-service-plugin.ts` 里 `storage/test` 的四处 `copy.` 调用。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/storage-test-locale.test.ts`，预期 10 个全绿，第一个用例的消息是 `存储连接测试成功（适配器：local）。`
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Refs #30335

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

The console prints the `storage/test` settings action's `message` as the toast, bare. Since #30551 the settings action route hands each action handler the caller's display language as the input's `locale` (`Accept-Language`, else `?locale`; `settings-routes.ts` `requestLocaleOf`). The storage handler now writes its answer in that language.

- New `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-test-copy.ts`: one entry per language on the platform locale table (`PLATFORM_LOCALES`): `en`, `zh-CN`, `zh-Hant`, `es-ES`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ja-JP`, `ko`. The four codes this package's bundles already used keep their keys. Four sentences each: success (still names the adapter), probe read back not the one written, S3 settings missing a bucket or a region, and a lead-in for an adapter's own error.
- `storage/test` reads `locale` from the handler input, the same source as the mail test notice in #30551. The adapter's own error text (S3 SDK, file system) stays verbatim: alone in English, as before; in another language behind the lead-in (`存储连接测试失败：…`), so the reader knows the rest is the adapter's untranslated report.
- `buildAdapterFromValues` throws a new `S3SettingsIncompleteError` with the same English message as before, so the settings re-apply path and its `warn` log line are byte-identical; only the `storage/test` answer reads the type to localise the refusal.
- Unchanged: `ok`, `severity`, the adapter name, the probe and its cleanup, every `ctx.logger` line, and every sentence an English or locale-less caller gets.

**Where the strings live, and one deviation from the precedent.** The precedent is #30376 (`mfa-required-enrollment-predicate.ts`): a settings handler's prose sits in a module-level copy table beside its code, not in the package's `translations/` bundles (those carry object metadata). This PR follows it, with one difference: the lookup does not use `@objectstack/core`'s `resolveLocale`. With both `zh-CN` and `zh-Hant` in one table, that ladder's base-language and first-variant steps answer `zh-TW` by key order, which is the trap the platform table's own reader warns about (`packages/spec/src/system/platform-locales.ts`, the `platformLocaleTagOf` note). So `storageTestCopyLocaleOf` reads the caller's code through `platformLocaleTagOf` (aliases `zh-TW`, `pt`, `en-US`; table tags `zh-Hans`, `ja`), then drops one subtag at a time (RFC 4647 lookup: `fr-CA` → `fr`, `zh-Hant-TW` → `zh-Hant`), and falls back to English. This is the gap #30538 names (`resolveBundleLocale` / `resolveLocale` do not read `platformLocaleTagOf`); once #30538 lands this module can go back to the shared resolver.

## Tests

New `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-test-locale.test.ts`, 10 cases, all through the REAL handler the plugin registers, on a real local adapter, with the input `locale` set or absent:

- zh-CN success sentence, `ok: true`, `severity: 'info'`; en-US success is the old English sentence;
- no locale, `tr-TR` (not on the table) and `''` answer the old English sentence;
- `zh` resolves to the zh-CN copy;
- zh-CN probe mismatch (`ok: false`, `severity: 'error'`), and the probe object is still removed;
- zh-CN incomplete S3 settings; no locale keeps the English S3 refusal;
- zh-CN adapter error = lead-in + the exact English adapter text;
- the table carries all 11 languages, every key in every language, placeholders verbatim, no non-English entry copied from English, and every `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS` tag finds its own entry;
- 24 code → entry mappings (aliases, table tags, shortened subtags, unknown → English).

Existing pins in `storage-service-plugin.test.ts` and `storage-service-plugin.probe-cleanup-store.test.ts` (English messages, no locale) pass unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Measured before the change on the real plugin handler (base `c23eafa8`): `locale: 'zh-CN'` and no locale both answered `Storage round-trip succeeded (adapter=local).`; mismatch `Probe download did not match upload.`; S3 `StorageServicePlugin: S3 adapter requires s3_bucket and s3_region`.
- `Clause-②: no`: nothing outside this package's own tests matches the English text (`git grep -n "round-trip succeeded\|did not match upload"` hits only `service-storage`). The console prints the message and reads `ok`.
- Arabic copy carries no bidi control characters; direction is the console's `dir`.
- An end-to-end pin through `SettingsService` + routes was not added here: service-storage has no service-settings dependency, and #30551 pins the route → handler `locale` hop.

## Verification
